name: Full Marketing Campaign
description: End-to-end marketing campaign for a small business — strategy, content, distribution, and reporting

parameters.label: Target Area / Market
parameters.placeholder: e.g. Pittsburgh metro, State College PA

steps.task: Research the competitive landscape and target audience for {{business_name}} ({{industry}}) in {{target_area}}. Goal: {{goal}}. Find: top local competitors, customer pain points, seasonal patterns, effective messaging angles, and platform-specific best practices. Budget context: {{budget}}.

Design the full marketing campaign strategy for {{business_name}}. Based on research, define: campaign positioning, core messaging, content pillars, platform mix ({{platforms}}), posting cadence, call-to-action strategy, and 30-60-90 day milestones. Goal: {{goal}}. Budget: {{budget}}.

Create content briefs and visual direction for the {{business_name}} marketing campaign. Define: brand voice, visual style guide, post templates for {{platforms}}, headline formulas, and image/video concepts for each content pillar. Provide 10 ready-to-use post ideas with captions.

Build out the content calendar for {{business_name}} — 30 days of scheduled posts across {{platforms}}. For each post include: date, platform, post type, caption, hashtags, image brief, and CTA. Export as a structured list the team can execute directly.

Define the distribution and growth strategy for {{business_name}}'s campaign. Include: paid ad targeting parameters (if budget allows: {{budget}}), organic growth tactics, local SEO plays, community engagement plan on {{platforms}}, and lead capture/follow-up sequence.

Create the campaign reporting framework for {{business_name}}. Define: KPIs to track (leads, reach, engagement, conversions), weekly review checklist, monthly report template, and success benchmarks for a {{goal}} campaign in {{industry}}.
